body:
HUMAN DECISION 2026-10-03 (relayed by the operator): every database table carries audit columns — created_at and updated_at (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL; updated_at maintained on every write) plus created_by/updated_by wherever an actor exists. Policy text: docs/guidance/databases.md section 2 (modelling) and section 8 (design/security review check); docs/guidance/architecture.md section 4 aligned.

Shipped schema today does not meet it: link has created_at only (no updated_at, no created_by/updated_by); audit_log has occurred_at only; user_agent_class has no audit columns; click has clicked_at only.

Please route: (1) every new table from now on complies at design time (02-click-retention and 01-analytics-v2 designs are in flight — the design agent should check its DDL before design review, the reviewer will apply the new section 8 check); (2) existing tables get the columns through an expand migration (NFR-X2, written rollback) in the slice that next touches them — click under 02-click-retention, link/audit_log/user_agent_class under whichever mission-02 slice you choose or a tiny follow-on slice; (3) anything deferred is a docs/qa/GAPS.md entry naming the migration that will add it. Record the decision in the mission NOTES. No reply needed.
summary: HUMAN DECISION: audit columns (created_at/updated_at + created_by/updated_by) on every table — guide updated; apply to in-flight designs, expand existing tables via migrations, GAPS for anything deferred
